function.name: generate_sound_wave
function.description: This function is for generating a sinusoidal sound wave file of a certain frequency for a specific duration and save it to a WAV file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

frequency.description: The frequency of the sound wave in Hz. This is a float type value.

duration.description: The duration of the sound in seconds.

wave_type.description: The waveform to be used to generate the sound.

function.name: play_sound_wave
function.description: This function is for playing a sound wave file. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

wave_file.description: The filename of the sound wave file to be played.

volume.description: The volume level at which the sound is to be played (1 is 100%). This is a float type value.
